description: The webview reaches the shell only through __TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke (ui/public/invoke-shim.js), which is injected unconditionally and carries no ACL surface; the app's own #[tauri::command] handlers are not ACL-gated (tauri 2.11.5 webview/mod.rs:1824 checks the ACL only for `plugin:` commands, for an app ACL manifest, or for a non-local origin — and tauri_build::build() registers no app manifest). So nothing is granted here on purpose: no core API, no privileged command, no fingerprinting surface. Any future core-plugin call must be added back by name, with its own capability entry.
